external_entities.name: member
external_entities.description: A grocery loyalty programme member who uses the mobile app and connects partner apps.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Members collect points when they shop

external_entities.name: partner app
external_entities.description: A web application run by another company, such as a meal-planning service that shows a member's points.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Partner apps are web applications that other companies run on their own servers

external_entities.name: browser
external_entities.description: The browser used by a member to sign in and approve consent for a partner app.
external_entities.source_excerpt: signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser

processes.name: mobile app
processes.description: The mobile application through which members sign in, call the rewards API, and manage partner-app connections.
processes.notes: The app keeps a refresh token on the phone. Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.

processes.name: authorization server
processes.description: The server that authenticates members, handles authorization-code flows, issues tokens, and manages partner-app consent.
processes.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
processes.notes: The authorization server accepts any redirect URI that starts with the registered URI and gives every partner app every scope.

processes.name: rewards API
processes.description: The API called by mobile and partner applications to access the points ledger and redeem points for gift cards.
processes.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger
processes.notes: The API does not check which client or audience a token was issued for.

processes.name: support console
processes.description: A web application that closes a member's account.
processes.source_excerpt: The support console is a web app that closes a member's account.
processes.notes: It is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

processes.name: partnerships team
processes.description: The team that manually registers partner apps and provides their client credentials.
processes.source_excerpt: Our partnerships team registers each partner app by hand

data_stores.name: identity database
data_stores.description: Database containing member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, consents, and account-closure state.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database

data_stores.name: points ledger
data_stores.description: Ledger containing every member's balance and every points transaction.
data_stores.source_excerpt: the points ledger, which holds every member's balance and every points transaction

data_stores.name: API log store
data_stores.description: Store receiving every request received by the rewards API, including headers.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: use mobile app
data_flows.description: A member uses the mobile application.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Members use our mobile app.
data_flows.data_description: Member loyalty activity and authentication data

data_flows.name: sign in member
data_flows.description: The mobile app signs the member in through the authorization server using the authorization code flow.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The app signs a member in through our authorization server with the authorization code flow
data_flows.notes: Nobody wrote down whether the app sends a PKCE challenge.
data_flows.data_description: Member sign-in credentials and authorization-code flow data

data_flows.name: call rewards API
data_flows.description: The mobile app calls the rewards API with an access token.
data_flows.source_excerpt: then calls the rewards API with the access token it gets back
data_flows.data_description: Access token and loyalty points data

data_flows.name: request token
data_flows.description: A partner app sends token requests containing its client secret.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The partner app sends that secret in the body of its token requests.
data_flows.data_description: Client ID, client secret, authorization codes, and tokens

data_flows.name: sign in and consent
data_flows.description: The browser carries out member sign-in and consent on the authorization server's sign-in page.
data_flows.source_excerpt: A member who connects a partner app signs in on the authorization server's sign-in page in their browser and approves a consent screen

data_flows.name: return authorization code
data_flows.description: The browser returns an authorization code to the partner app's redirect URI.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The browser then returns to the partner app's redirect URI with an authorization code.

data_flows.name: show points
data_flows.description: A partner app uses the rewards API to show a member's points.
data_flows.source_excerpt: a meal-planning service that shows a member's points

data_flows.name: keep identity data
data_flows.description: The authorization server keeps member identity, authorization, token, and consent data in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The authorization server keeps member accounts, email addresses and password hashes in the identity database, together with the authorization codes, refresh tokens and consents it issues.
data_flows.data_description: Member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents

data_flows.name: read and write ledger
data_flows.description: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API reads and writes the points ledger

data_flows.name: write request logs
data_flows.description: The rewards API writes each received request, including headers, to the API log store.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The rewards API also writes every request it receives, headers included, to the API log store.

data_flows.name: close member account
data_flows.description: The support console marks a member's account closed in the identity database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Closing an account marks it closed in the identity database.

data_flows.name: obtain access token
data_flows.description: The support console takes access tokens from the authorization server.
data_flows.source_excerpt: It takes access tokens from the same authorization server

trust_boundaries.name: own cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The system components described as running in the organisation's own cloud account.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Everything below runs in our own cloud account

trust_boundaries.name: members' phones
trust_boundaries.description: The members' phones, which are outside the organisation's cloud account.

trust_boundaries.name: partner apps' own servers
trust_boundaries.description: Servers owned or operated by other companies for their partner applications.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: partner apps that other companies run on their own servers

assumptions.assumption: The support console is internet-facing because it is served on a public hostname.
assumptions.basis: The text says the support console is served on the same public hostname as the rewards API.

assumptions.assumption: The rewards API is internet-facing because it is served on the same public hostname as the support console.
assumptions.basis: The text says the support console and rewards API use the same public hostname.

assumptions.assumption: The identity database is confidential because it contains member personal data, password hashes, tokens, and consents.
assumptions.basis: The described contents include member accounts, email addresses, password hashes, authorization codes, refresh tokens, and consents.

assumptions.assumption: The points ledger is confidential because it contains member balances and transaction records.
assumptions.basis: The described contents include every member's balance and every points transaction.

assumptions.assumption: The API log store is confidential because it contains request headers and requests associated with member and token activity.
assumptions.basis: The store receives every request and its headers from the rewards API.
